title: Independent computational reproduction
requirement: Separately written code recomputes the stated result. Record inputs, exact arithmetic and the scope of reproduction.

title: Independent certificate verification
requirement: A separate checker verifies the certificate against its exact predicate, including coverage where required by the claim. State the soundness relationship and any unchecked assumptions.

title: Kernel-checked mathematical proof
summary: Identify the kernel, derivation and assumptions.
requirement: A named kernel checks a derivation of the exact statement. Identify the source, kernel version, assumptions and correspondence to the intended claim.
